sentences: Respondents prioritize critical thinking and data literacy over coding, viewing AI as a tool needing human oversight.
There is consensus on public awareness and mandatory education regarding AI's limitations, hallucinations, and biases.
Many advocate integrating AI literacy into K-12 and post-secondary institutions.
Respondents see libraries and community centres as vital hubs for accessible training.
Recommendations focus on infrastructure, devices, and multilingual programming to ensure equitable access for underserved demographics.
A vocal minority expresses skepticism regarding AI's environmental and ethical risks.
text: Respondents prioritize critical thinking and data literacy over coding, viewing AI as a tool needing human oversight. There is consensus on public awareness and mandatory education regarding AI's limitations, hallucinations, and biases. Many advocate integrating AI literacy into K-12 and post-secondary institutions. Respondents see libraries and community centres as vital hubs for accessible training. Recommendations focus on infrastructure, devices, and multilingual programming to ensure equitable access for underserved demographics. A vocal minority expresses skepticism regarding AI's environmental and ethical risks.
